text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: latency spikes >= 3x for tenant OrchardHealth on dedicated-pool-07. Error rate 5% 5xx, queue depth high. Trigger: latency_slo_breach. Link: https://incidents.redwood/1923456789

alice_oncall: I'm awake, oncall here. Looking at dashboards now. What's the impact? :coffee:

ben_sre: I'm pulling logs. Initial signal: sudden 4x qps burst from IP range 34.22.0.0/16, lots of long-context streaming reqs. Queue depth on pool-07 at 98%. Seeing many batches hitting max_batch_tokens and timing out/OOMing.

cam_engineer: Confirmed. Model workers showing OOMs when batch tokens > ~1200. Scheduler kept packing requests into large batches because client sends long prompts + streaming enabled. We have a soft global cap but no tenant-specific knob in prod yet.

alice_oncall: Ok immediate plan: 1) apply per-tenant batch cap, 2) throttle tenant QPS, 3) enable fallback smaller model for long requests. Who can run admin? @eric_platform can you apply?

eric_platform: On it. Running admin CLI to patch scheduler knobs for tenant OrchardHealth.

eric_platform: ```
# reduce max_batch_tokens and disable continuous batching for tenant OrchardHealth
rw-admin tenant update-orchard --set scheduler.max_batch_tokens=512 --set scheduler.continuous_batching=false
# apply token cap and qps limiter
rw-admin tenant update-orchard --set ingress.qps_limit=18 --set ingress.concurrent_requests=30
```

eric_platform: Applied. Returned 200. Rolling config to pool-07.

incident-bot: CONFIG-ROLL: orchard_scheduler_patch started by eric_platform (cfg id cfg-78f3). Rollout status: 20% -> 100% in 90s.

ben_sre: After change: queue depth down to 22%, P50 latency back to normal, error rate down to 0.6%. No more worker OOMs in logs.

cam_engineer: Also set routing to divert very large-token requests to smaller model variant (m-infer-xt-8) to reduce memory pressure. Command used:
```
rw-admin routing set orchard --rule "if tokens > 8000 => m-infer-xt-8"
```

dana_cs: Notifying the customer now (OrchardHealth PM + Ops). Drafting note: short summary, mitigations, next steps, and postmortem ETA. Asking them if they changed any clients/traffic patterns.

alice_oncall: Good. I'll monitor next 30m and then handoff to daytime oncall @ben_sre at 08:00 UTC. Add to incident tracker: INC-2026-0456.

ben_sre: I'll take it. Please attach logs and config diffs to the incident record. Also propose a follow-up: bespoke tuning work item — analyze prompt length distribution and recommend per-tenant throttles or prefix caching to avoid giant batches.

cam_engineer: Follow-ups noted: 1) implement tenant-aware max_batch_tokens heuristics; 2) autoscaling for pool-07 with warm spare nodes; 3) provide customer-facing rate-limiter options (burst/QPS).

dana_cs: OrchardHealth acknowledged mitigation and asked for timeline on root cause and long-term fix. I'll coordinate access for deeper logs and schedule a post-incident meeting.

alice_oncall: TL;DR: paging for OrchardHealth due to burst of long-context requests causing oversized batches -> worker OOMs. Immediate mitigations: lowered max_batch_tokens to 512, disabled continuous batching for tenant, applied qps and concurrency caps, routed large requests to smaller model. System stable. Next: postmortem and tenant-specific throttling design.

incident-bot: INCIDENT-RESOLVED: INC-2026-0456 resolved by alice_oncall, ben_sre, eric_platform, cam_engineer. Duration 00:28:20. Please file postmortem in /incidents/postmortems/inc-2026-0456.

alice_oncall: Thanks all. :thumbsup: I'll close this thread once postmortem link is attached.
